name: html-paint
description: An image editor in the spirit of Paint.NET — layers, selections, effects — as one standalone HTML file

scripts.test: node tests/color.mjs && node tests/raster.mjs && node tests/filters.mjs && node tests/zip.mjs && node tests/i18n.mjs
scripts.shots: node build.mjs && mkdir -p shots && node --experimental-websocket tests/app.mjs --shots shots
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
